notes_for_extractor: Hardest book in group B: strikethrough revision text is in the text layer and must be filtered (needs drawing/line-strike detection or it will corrupt catalog/mfr/qty), multi-line wrapped cells need row reconstruction by y-bands/columns, and many groups span pages with orphaned headers. 190 groups — good large gold candidate only if strike-through is handled.
